messages:
Sahil: quick sync — follow-up to the multi-region RFC. short question: do we want a PKI-backed "lease"/consent handshake for tenant writes in active-active? thinking signed lease tokens at the proxy to prove control-plane consent.
Lucy: +1 on signed lease tokens. prevents accidental cross-region writes and gives us audit trail.
Devon: big question: who holds the signing key? control-plane central signer = simpler audit, edge signer = lower latency. tradeoffs?
Amanda: proposal: control-plane issues short-lived proxy certs (30s-2m). proxies use ephemeral keys to sign per-write assertions. root keys stay in KMS/HSM.
Sahil: flow idea: client -> proxy; proxy verifies tenant residency; if tenant not resident and no consent token -> reject 403. if consent supplied (JWS) and verified -> allow. consent tokens are short-lived and include region, tenant_id, and nonce.
Devon: what about control-plane outage? proxies can't get new certs. we need a graceful grace period: cached certs allowed for a bounded window (eg 45s) and a degradable mode.
Lucy: edge-case: partition with metros split — we might accept writes in both regions under soft-consent then reconcile. need sweep & compensating transactions.
Amanda: implementation steps I suggest:
- spec the header: X-Region-Consent: compact JWS (kid points to control-plane signing cert)
- control-plane: cert issuer + endpoint to mint consent tokens
- proxy: verification lib + cache + backoff to control-plane
- operator: rollout with kill-switch and telemetry
(keep each piece small)
Sahil: also need authz mapping: which roles can ask for tenant-consent? UI/API guardrails.
Devon: metrics: consent-verification-latency (ms), consent-cache-hit-rate, consent-mismatch-count, soft-accept-rate. tag by region and tenant tier.
Lucy: legal/ops: confirm we can persist token metadata into audit logs (no secret material — only kid and tenant). pinging legal.
Amanda: infra notes: we'll use HSM-backed signing in prod, rotate root keys monthly, and use short-lived issuance for proxies. created INFRA-2345.
infra-bot: CI/CD: started canary for "proxy-consent-verifier" in eu-west-1 (deployment id: dep-5773-canary).
Devon: TTL/grace values to settle: propose cert-ttl=90s, token-ttl=30s, grace=60s; open to pushback.
Sahil: +1 on those defaults. add config knobs per deployment.
Lucy: small UX ask for operators: a per-tenant override flag for temporary migrations (name: residency.override_until). must require audit entry.
Amanda: timeline: spec + API review this week, control-plane PR next week, proxy lib the following. will post design doc.
Sahil: risks: (1) increased verification latency on the write path — mitigate via local cache and batching verifies, (2) accidental acceptance during long partitions — mitigations: sweep + compensating ops + operator alerting, (3) key compromise — mitigate via HSM + rotation + revocation lists.
Devon: question: can we piggyback existing X-Region-Assertion header to avoid adding new plumbing? use same header but change payload shape to include jti/iss/exp.
Lucy: fine as long as format is backward compatible. add version field in the claim.
Amanda: action items: Amanda -> create INFRA-2345 with design and rollout checklist; Devon -> telemetry PR for new metrics; Lucy -> legal + logging confirmation; Sahil -> write short operator runbook for soft-accept mode.
Sahil: thanks team. I’ll schedule 30m follow-up on Fri to lock TTLs and signers. 
Lucy: :thumbsup:
Amanda: noted, will link the doc in this thread.
infra-bot: canary deployment complete: proxy-consent-verifier v0.1 -> stable? pending 2h of perf checks.
